question: Who among the following received Padma Bhushan 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Victor Banerjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Victor Banerjee,** a three-time National Award winner, was given the** Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award,** in the field of art by the Indian government in 2022.
 
• At Rashtrapati Bhavan, the President also handed out four Padma Vibhushans and 107 Padma Shri.
 
• In David Lean's film **"A Passage to India"**, Banerjee played Dr. Aziz Ahmed, bringing him to the notice of western audiences.
 
• In 1986, he was nominated for a BAFTA award for the part, which he won as well as the Evening Standard British Film Award and the NBR Award (National Board Review, USA). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **President Ram Nath Kovind** honoured **Konsam Ibomcha Singh**, a traditional Laiphadibi doll maker from Manipur, with the Padma Shri Award for Arts.
 
• **Lourembam Bino Devi** is a practitioner and popularizer of Manipur's appliqué craft, known as Leeba in Meitei.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Padma Bhushan** is the Republic of India's third-highest civilian award, after the Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan, and before the Padma Shri.
 
• The award, which was established on January 2, 1954, recognizes "distinguished service of a high order...without difference of race, occupation, status, or sex."
 
• The award criteria include "service in any discipline, including service performed by Government workers," such as doctors and scientists, but exclude individuals who work for government-owned businesses.
